title: Doesn’t keep things hot
text:
Doesn’t keep things hot. I bought this and hoped it would keep my tea or golden milk, hot for longer. It didn’t. I’ve had uncovered mugs that kept things hotter for much longer.
It’s a beautiful mug and I will use it but it’s not the mug and I will go to. It just doesn’t keep things hot.
